metadata.methods_description: Continuous EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz from 31 active Ag/AgCl electrodes (10/20 system, actiChamp Plus; ground FPz, online reference FCz). Participants completed a within-subject RDK left/right motion discrimination task with baseline, low-level prior and high-level prior conditions. Motion coherence was individualized with two QUEST staircases targeting 75% accuracy. Stimuli were presented with PsychoPy on a 240 Hz monitor at 65 cm viewing distance. Post-experimental questionnaires assessed manipulation checks, belief strength, psychosis proneness and psychological flexibility.
